title: Our tour of Seville by Carlos
text:
Our tour guide was Carlos what an incredible young knowledgeable man.
His English is amazing and showed us so much he obviously loves his city and it came through with his absolute enthusiasm.
I highly recommend this tour one of the best tours we have been on during our travels across Europe.
P.s good luck to Betis tomorrow Carlos.
author: 658justinak

title: Lovely tour guide. Learned a lot!
text: Lovely tour guide, Concha, taught us the history, architecture, and traditions of her city. Make sure to arrive early - it is 100% worth it!
author: Alex_L

title: Entertaining and informative
text: This small group tour was a perfect introduction to Seville and its history. Our guide, Carlos, was charming, entertaining and informative. I would highly recommend this tour especially for first time visitors to the city.
author: Maria_N

title: Great introduction to the city
text: Clara was so engaging and we enjoyed every minute of our tour with her. It was a great introduction to the city - not too much but not too little.
author: 58melanieq

title: Interesting tour with a great guide
text: Christina was a great guide. Very knowledgeable and lots of interesting info about this wonderful city. Highly recommend
author: Linswah

title: Very informative tour
text: Really excellent tour , Martha was a wealth of knowledge and really enjoyed listening to the history of Seville while visiting the key sights . Highly recommend
author: Elaine_D

title: Great introduction to Seville
text: Well worth the money. Valentin was an erudite and engaging guide with a lot of enthusiasm for the city and its sights.
author: Kevin_S

title: Amazing
text: Valentin was very friendly and knowledgeable and also passionate about Seville! We enjoyed the walk very much and will certainly return to Seville in April for the orange blossoming season, as recommended by Valentin.
